input.quote: (b) Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman. If Sparkling terminates this Agreement pursuant to this Section 17(b), Sparkling shall cease using the Software at the end of the ninety (90) day notice period, and shall certify to Garman within thirty (30) calendar days of termination that Sparkling has destroyed or has returned to Garman all Software, Documentation and Codes.
input.rationale: Section 17 addresses post-termination effects in one direction only: Sparkling must cease use and return or destroy Garman's Software, Documentation and Codes, and on Garman default the license converts to perpetual with a refund of prepaid fees. Nothing anywhere in the Agreement obliges Garman to return Sparkling's data (which Garman handles under Section 4(b) data conversion and in the course of maintenance and support) or to provide any exit or migration assistance; the survival list in Section 18 contains no such obligation, and the Section 16 escrow/on-site Codes only address software continuity, not data return. The rule's fallback (90 days of assistance plus data export within 30 days) is therefore unmet, so we inserted the preferred position as a new Section 17(d): up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of our data in machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and data return/deletion obligation as Section 17(d)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit provision: on expiry or termination Garman provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days and then certifies deletion. Our playbook requires a data-return and exit-help obligation; we can accept ninety days of assistance if six months is difficult.

ops.text: (d) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Garman shall (1) at Sparkling's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Garman's then-current rates; (2) within thirty (30) calendar days of Sparkling's request, return to Sparkling all of Sparkling's data in its possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (3) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Sparkling in writing.
